newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Nov 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Nov 12.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Al-Azizia Panda Company buys six central markets worth $27 million in the Eastern province.
- New statistics show that Yemeni oil profits in the first nine months of 1996 were $618 million.
- Kuwaiti Industrial Bank offers ten industrial petrochemical projects to the public sector. REUTERS
